description: Research-backed prose rewriting skill that targets structural AI-writing patterns (clause distribution, burstiness, nominalization, stance) rather than word-swapping. The only humanizer based on peer-reviewed linguistics research.

plugins.name: not-ai
plugins.description: Rewrite prose so it reads like a person wrote it. Uses PNAS 2025 research on morphosyntactic features to target the structural layer: clause types, sentence burstiness, nominalization density, epistemic stance. Includes deterministic Python measurement scripts, 8 genre profiles, and a pre-output gate with counted values. The only humanizer that measures before rewriting.
